intent: A warm-ivory sailcloth gown for the Sunken Shelf, rope-laced front and back into a narrow driftwood belt, with a flared hip ruffle, a stepped bell skirt over a darker back train and sand bow, slim bell cuffs and a raised knotted headscarf with a shell boss - reading from the high camera as a narrow waist over a wide, layered A.
reason: Sailcloth gown: a laced bodice and torn sailcloth drapes, the most on-theme for the wrecks, all salt and ivory (6.1, third).
first_fix: Almost all salt-white, so from above it blurs into one pale block near linen: add a driftwood or brass corset for contrast and angle the side tatters back onto the skirt.
